warnings.message: uv: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for uv 0.13.6, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (required-version in [tool.uv], .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: uv: no-binary-package lets docopt be built from source while building is forbidden for everything else; uv then always builds it from source, even where a wheel exists, because it has no setting that only allows building
warnings.fix: If pypi:docopt has a wheel and needs no build, remove it from installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: uv: uv.lock records exclude-newer and exclude-newer-package, so it is out of date after this change
warnings.fix: Run uv lock and commit uv.lock; until then uv sync --locked and uv lock --check fail
